updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-25 1641
updates.notes:
New: Online play - host a game or join one from the LOBBY and play your friends
New: Versus Co-op - team up with a friend, 2 on 2
New: Sentinel joins the roster, plus a new stage: Syphon Pyramid
New: Command List and Rematch in the pause menu
Change: Every fighter updated to their latest version, with a new fight screen
Change: Lots of fixes and polish all over the game
Change: Come play online! The game keeps itself up to date, so everyone in the lobby is on the same version
Change: Seen a desync (the two players see different things)? Report it in bug reports in the CU Discord with both teams, the stage, what happened and about when, and the replay from your save\replays folder if you have it

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-25 1812
updates.notes: New: Steam Deck and Linux players can now update from inside the game, like everyone else

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-25 1833
updates.notes: Fix: Picking Roll no longer crashes the game

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-25 1929
updates.notes: Fix: Everyone online can see each other's rooms again (removed a few leftover files that made some games look like a different version)

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-26 0040
updates.notes:
New: Lilith is a hidden character: move right from Morrigan on the select screen (own portrait, select icon and move list)
New: PLAYERS ONLINE: see who is online right now and challenge them directly from the lobby
New: Your game version shows in the lobby, so you can check you and your opponent are on the same update
Change: Input delay is AUTO by default (picked from your connection at the start of each match); fixed 0 - 10 is still in Netplay Settings
Change: New Rollback Smoothing option (on by default): after a rollback, fighters slide into place instead of snapping
Change: Smoother online matches: the two games keep each other in step during the match, so rollbacks stay small
Change: Netplay Settings: the port options are gone
Change: Sentinel updated to Beximus's latest version (fixes a crash)
Change: Morrigan: the assist screen shows TYPE A / TYPE B / TYPE G correctly, and she no longer switches to Lilith there
Change: Morrigan and Lilith: the Down, Down + 2 Kicks transformation is turned off for now
Fix: The round timer no longer draws over the fighters, and it hides along with the life bars
Fix: The WINS counters sit in the right place again

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-26 0139
updates.notes:
New: Updates now install by themselves: when a new update is out, the game downloads it, installs it and restarts on its own (nothing to press). This is the last update you install the old way
Fix: Ibuki: fixed a broken check in one of her moves

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-26 1915
updates.notes:
New: Watch online matches live: pick a room in the LOBBY and choose WATCH, even mid-match. You catch up to the current match and watch it a few seconds behind the players
New: RANDOM TEST (WATCH > RANDOM TEST): endless 3v3 CPU fights on random stages until you press Esc. Every fighter plays once before anyone repeats
Change: Select screen: new character portrait art
Fix: The WINS counters and lifebars no longer move after the round ends
Fix: Lilith no longer turns into Morrigan while jumping in; she now uses her own jump-in animation the whole way

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-26 2239
updates.notes:
New: Watch PLAYERS ONLINE matches: when two players are in a match, press WATCH on their card to watch it live, a few seconds behind the players
Fix: Chun-Li: fixed animations 17000-17002
Fix: Lei-Lei: fixed a palette issue that kept you from picking her other palettes
Fix: Captain Commando: restored his missing light Captain Corridor (it was missing from the last 2 updates)

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-27 1214
updates.notes:
Change: Training: pick any stage, and the attack data (dizzy, damage, total damage, max combo) shows on every stage, not just the training stage
Change: Sakura: her move list no longer shows Dark Sakura (CPU only for now)
Fix: PLAYERS ONLINE no longer crashes the game when you open it
Fix: CPU teams now always start with exactly one fighter on point (before, CPU teammates could disagree on the start order, leaving nobody on stage or two fighters on point)
Fix: Snap backs: a fighter snapped out no longer comes back in with broken animations after a second snap (most visible with Sentinel's snap)
Fix: Assist select screen: the cards were drawn too big and too low on Syphon Pyramid
Fix: Assist select screen: TYPE cards no longer blink blank for some characters (Batsu, Chun-Li, C.Viper, Haggar, Hugo, Jin, Pure, Q, Rolento, Yang)
Fix: Sakura: her assist could get stuck offscreen when her point fighter was hit during it, leaving her team with nobody on stage
Fix: Saki: an assist path pointed to a state she doesn't have

updates.name: CU Update 2026-11-28 0205
updates.notes:
Fix: Lilith: her assist cards no longer show Morrigan (the card flying in on the assist screen, and the chosen card from the second match on)
Fix: F4 / Rematch: the 2nd and 3rd assist cards could no longer be picked after a restart (the teammates were left on CPU input)
Change: F4 and Rematch keep the assists you picked and skip the assist select screen (go back to the select screen to change them); Rematch also restarts right away instead of reloading the fighters, and both skip the VS screen (a short white fade, then the fight)
